What is Development Services?

The Development Services Department is responsible for providing accurate and efficient building and planning services to the Garden City community. Development Services assists with planning questions and applications, building and auxiliary permitting services, regional planning and transportation efforts, floodplain administration, and committee facilitation.

 

What is Our Mission?

The primary purpose of Development Services is to assist in the advancement of the City in the direction envisioned by the Garden City Comprehensive Plan. We are committed to providing Garden City residents, business owners, and stakeholders with accurate, friendly, efficient and cost effective customer service. Our progressive approach is intended to facilitate and protect economic growth and stability, public safety, environmental enhancement and sustainability, community responsibility and engagement. It is our intent to promote social equity through the identification and implementation of superior building and land use standards and practices.
